entries.title: Fix `resource_local_to_scene` may fail during instantiating scene
Fix issue with incomplete property overrides in C# sourcegen
Windows: Fix `DirAccess::is_equivalent` for external and network drives
Make `NodePath` copy-on-write, to avoid it changing accidentally (through copies)
Allow shader containers to be loaded in parallel.
entries.reason: Paired shader-cache concurrency change: upstream asynchronous cache loading lacks the current synchronous source-recompile fallback on failed shader creation and overwrites failed placeholder RIDs with null. Requires recovery/ownership adaptation and concurrent GPU cache validation. Current shader_create_from_bytecode_with_samplers retains its driver-call mutex, so the Metal race is not introduced here.

entries.reason: Upstream move-selection hunks restore Bezier handle modes using pre-move key indices after key ordering can change; duplicate-overwrite undo reinserts old values without restoring old handle modes. Requires time-based key identification plus overlapping-key move/copy/paste/undo/redo regression coverage before adoption.

entries.reason: Patch conflicts with older inspector/connection callback structure. Resolving a deleted edited object to nullptr makes edit(nullptr) return early on pointer equality, skipping stale-editor cleanup; several newly resolved pointers are dereferenced without null guards. Requires ObjectID-based state comparison and deferred deletion/clear/edit callback regression coverage.
